body:
My MC Username: FluffyHairz

Reason: "Speed Hacking"

Reason I should be un-banned: The ban was false. (I would like to see the evidence).

Evidence to prove the ban was false: Ill show staff my MC folder if they wish, as there is nothing there.

Have i waited long enough to be appealed?: I wasn't hacking, so i shouldn't have been banned , so i think I've waited long enough.

Have I been caught ban evading?: No, this is my first ban and I have not evaded it.

Have I appealed a ban before?:No I have not appealed a ban before.

Thanks for reading      -FluffyHairz
